name: Wesley Joseph
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I began moving freight on a borrowed forklift with a missing armrest.” People around the blocks below Foundry Lofts know Wesley by a small Sunday habit. Wesley checks the little hand-lettered notices around Harbour Supply.
voice: We used to swap the sweet things. With my new shift I don't know anybody's favorite.
appearance: Wesley has short, uneven waves that refuse to lie flat, a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones, and a favorite piece of clothing, an unlined tan jacket. It usually goes with a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case. When somebody else has the floor, Wesley listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Wesley tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Wesley will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To exchange lunch treats with one new shift mate.
family: Imani Ford is Wesley’s half-sibling. Wesley makes the call. Imani is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *A call heard twice*, Imani says, “I took the first call and lost the connection.”
connections: John Hong. They argue over whether a working lunch tin is ready to become a museum piece.

reactions.situation: An old tin is claimed by two crews
reactions.response: Wesley invites both crews to describe the lid without putting either at fault.
reactions.asWritten: An old tin is claimed by two crews. Wesley invites both crews to describe the lid without putting either at fault.

reactions.situation: A stranger offers money to cut ahead of an exhausted neighbor
reactions.response: Wesley tells the stranger when the next opening is, then stays with the neighbor until their turn comes.
reactions.asWritten: A stranger offers money to cut ahead of an exhausted neighbor. Wesley tells the stranger when the next opening is, then stays with the neighbor until their turn comes.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Wesley repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
